title: Agent workspace configuration
description: Project-specific roster, execution policy, repository boundaries, and Backlog integration for the shared coordination CLI.

$schema.description: Relative path or URI of this configuration's JSON Schema for editor assistance.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format understood by the coordination CLI.

defaultAgent.description: Name of a configured roster member used when no agent is selected. The CLI checks that this name exists.

staleAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without a heartbeat before status flags a session as stale. Staleness never releases ownership.

agents.description: Project-specific agent roster, independent of provider or model. The CLI enforces unique names.

repositories.description: Git repository boundaries and checks, relative to this workspace. Use a single root entry for a normal repo or monorepo.

executionPolicy.description: Required defaults and rules used to resolve a run. Runs snapshot these values; changing them affects future runs.

defaultProfile.description: Key in profiles used unless overridden by the agent or run. The CLI checks that this profile exists.

profiles.description: Named execution profiles. Names and settings may vary by project.

permissions.description: External actions are unsupported by this helper and remain disabled. Local commit permission is configured per profile.

push.description: This helper does not push commits.

merge.description: This helper does not merge branches or pull requests.

tags.description: This helper does not create or publish tags.

deployment.description: This helper does not deploy applications.

profile.description: Independent controls for delegation, review, local commits, human input, and bounded work. Every field must be specified.

delegation.description: Use one agent or permit useful independent workers and reviewers. Single requires maxAgents=1.

maxAgents.description: Maximum concurrent registered agents, including the coordinator and reviewers. Independent review requires at least two.

review.description: Require author review or a genuinely separate reviewer in the same run. Independent review also applies when commits are disabled.

commits.description: Leave changes uncommitted, require an explicit commit request, or allow guarded local commits within an authorized scoped run.

onHumanInput.description: Ask the user for material input, or record a gated handoff and continue independent eligible work.

maxTasks.description: Maximum distinct tasks attempted in a run, including deferred tasks.

maxMinutes.description: Elapsed run limit before new claims or worker starts are refused. Cleanup remains allowed.

name.description: Unique lowercase nickname used in task assignment and session registration. Chat selection is case-insensitive.

role.description: Human-readable responsibility, such as coordinator, builder, or reviewer.

focus.description: Project-specific guidance for choosing this agent.

defaultProfile.description: Optional key in executionPolicy.profiles overriding the project default. An explicit run profile takes precedence.

path.description: Workspace-relative Git repository path using forward slashes, with no parent traversal. Use . for the workspace repository.

purpose.description: Why this repository exists and how agents should use it.

readOnly.description: Prevent writable claims and guarded commits in this repository.

checks.description: All checks required by guarded verification, executed in this repository. A nonempty list is required to verify a snapshot.

name.description: Readable check name used in verification evidence.

command.description: Executable followed by literal arguments, without shell expansion. BACKLOG_CWD points to the workspace.

backlog.description: Native Backlog CLI command and project-specific lifecycle names.

command.description: Backlog executable or package manager launcher.

args.description: Optional launcher arguments placed before the native Backlog command.

testedVersion.description: Documented Backlog version verified against this project; does not install or pin the executable.

todoStatus.description: Configured Backlog status for available or paused work.

activeStatus.description: Configured Backlog status for claimed work.

doneStatus.description: Configured Backlog status for verified completion.

reviewLabel.description: Label for a released agent-review handoff, separate from the human-review gate.
